# FlareIdeLayout

`Flare.Components.IDE.FlareIdeLayout`

Root layout component for an IDE-style interface. Arranges ribbon, menu bar, tool panels, document area, bottom panel, and status bar in a Visual Studio-style layout. All styling is composed from base Flare CSS classes and design tokens - no custom tokens. The layout owns each region's collapsed state so a collapsed panel frees its docked space (shrinking to a thin rail), and supports per-region auto-hide (flyout) panels. The bottom region can draw a tool-window header with pin and collapse controls: pinned keeps it docked, unpinned turns it into an auto-hide flyout. The Center region draws its dock strip; a side region draws one only while it has documents, so an empty side reserves no strip row, and the strip's compact region control returns from a covering document to the tool group.

## Methods

### `OnFlyoutEscapeAsync(string position)`

Called by the IDE's JS module when Escape is pressed while an auto-hide flyout is open. Collapses the region through LeftCollapsed, RightCollapsed or BottomCollapsed and returns focus to the active tool's rail entry, or to the region rail for the bottom, on the next render; a region the host already collapsed, and a docked region, are left alone. The bottom participates only while it is unpinned.
Returns: `Task`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `string` | The region whose flyout is open: Left, Right or Bottom. |

### `OnFlyoutOutsidePressAsync(string position)`

Called by the IDE's JS module when a pointer press lands outside an open auto-hide flyout and outside its rail. Collapses the region through LeftCollapsed, RightCollapsed or BottomCollapsed; a region the host already collapsed, and a docked region, are left alone. The bottom participates only while it is unpinned.
Returns: `Task`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `string` | The region whose flyout is open: Left, Right or Bottom. |

### `ResizePanel(string position, int sizePx)`

Sets a docked region size in pixels. Pointer and keyboard interaction are handled by FlareSplitter.
Returns: `void`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `position` | `string` | The region being resized. |
| `sizePx` | `int` | The new size in pixels. |
